recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring a woman in the foreground wearing an intricate silver lace mask, while a man in the background, partially obscured by shadows, adjusts the mask. The lighting is focused on the woman's face and the metallic texture of the mask, creating a moody, dramatic atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground woman as the primary focal point with sharp eye contact
Background man as a secondary, supportive figure creating depth
Hands framing the woman's face to direct the viewer's eye
Contrast between the detailed silver lace and the deep black background
coreInvariants: Intricate filigree texture on the mask

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Woman is centered and large-scale in the lower two-thirds; man is positioned behind her, slightly offset and softer in focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's eyes, framed by the silver lace mask.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves outward to the hands adjusting the mask, then upward to the man's face and the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper half and corners to emphasize the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal shadows provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool-toned skin tones and silver highlights provide contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Piercing blue eyes act as the primary color accent.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic black and white with subtle skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif and modern geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the secondary text
Translucent layering for large display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large 'DARKER' text uses a semi-transparent fill to blend with the background

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the base of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic serif for the title to evoke drama; wide-spaced sans-serif for technical info to provide a modern anchor.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom text
High-contrast serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the cinematic, classical serif feel of the main title.
Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric look for the bottom metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dramatic low-key portrait of a woman with blue eyes wearing a highly detailed silver lace masquerade mask. Behind her, a man's hands are visible adjusting the mask. The background is solid black, and the lighting is cool-toned and moody, focusing on the textures of the lace and skin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a high-contrast serif font in the top right, using a semi-transparent grey fill. Add a single line of wide-tracked sans-serif text in white at the very bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the mask texture sharp and metallic?
Is the lighting strictly low-key with deep blacks?
Is the bottom text tracking sufficiently wide?
Does the top text have a translucent quality?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue eye color
Complexity of the lace mask pattern
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact movie title wording
Ensure the mask is a unique lace pattern
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic skin texture under the mask
Ensure the hands look natural and integrated
Verify the silver highlights on the mask are bright but not blown out
Confirm the typography does not obscure the woman's eyes
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Metallic lace texture + High-contrast serif typography + Wide-tracked sans-serif anchor.
